name: AirPlay
description: Play from an iPhone, iPad or Mac to Kalinka Player over AirPlay. Unofficial AirPlay 2 and classic AirPlay receiver; not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

notes: Requires Kalinka Player server 5.9.0 or newer (below 6.0.0), which brings plugin SDK 3.11, and a Kalinka Player renderer 0.5.0 or newer (below 1.0.0) with live stream support. The audio plays through the renderer selected in Kalinka Player, on this or another machine; the server itself opens no audio hardware.

The package bundles shairport-sync 5.5.2 with AirPlay 2 and nqptp 1.2.8, built against Debian 13's libraries, which apt checks on install. It installs on Debian 13 and on 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS 13 or DietPi based on it, on amd64 or arm64; a 32-bit userspace does not qualify.

AirPlay 2 needs UDP ports 319 and 320 for nqptp; the package grants the server CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE for it. Keep a distribution shairport-sync or nqptp service disabled. When the ports are taken, classic AirPlay is offered instead. A firewall must allow UDP 5353, TCP 7000, UDP 319-320 and 6000-6009, and the ephemeral range 32768-60999 over TCP and UDP.

This independent integration is not certified or endorsed by Apple. Remote control from Kalinka Player (pause, play, next, previous) reaches classic AirPlay senders only; AirPlay 2 senders are controlled from the sending device.
